free_text: The decision to recommend biopsy is supported by high-risk findings, specifically the PI-RADS 5 lesion and elevated PSA of 7.6 ng/mL. Although the patient has no lower urinary tract symptoms (IPSS 0), the combination of these imaging results and prior risk factors necessitates further investigation. Therefore, a prostate biopsy is recommended to assess the extent of the suspicious area.
